overview.match: L. David Patterson is a financial advisor and business consultant.
overview.text: L. David Patterson previously served as Hawthorne City Treasurer and as a Hawthorne city councilmember. He serves as the chief deputy treasurer for the City of Carson. In a 2024 questionnaire, he said that as treasurer he increased the city's annual investment returns from $30,000 to over $500,000 and reduced banking fees by hundreds of thousands of dollars annually. He also stated that as a councilmember he chaired the Financial Oversight Committee and introduced protocols that helped grow the city's cash balance from $5 million to $100 million.
